  • Drive for Excellence by being agile, innovative and efficient
  • Do What's Right by acting safely, ethically, and sustainably
Overview
The person in this role demonstrates a high level of professionalism, prioritizing the development of innovative solutions to improve results within the virtual desktop environment. Responsibilities include leveraging in-depth knowledge of Bunge’s business and strategy to develop solutions, contributing to process improvements, and driving results through high standards, focus on key priorities, and preparing for technological changes. This role also involves providing technical guidance and mentorship to professionals and support staff.
Essential Functions: Main Accountabilities
  • Manage specific projects or processes related to virtual desktop infrastructure, operating independently with limited supervision.
  • Participate in projects of moderate complexity, contributing to continuous process improvements within BT Infrastructure.
  • Responsible for the effective execution of core activities within the virtual desktop environment, ensuring important results are obtained.
  • Possess in-depth knowledge of virtual desktop technologies and a basic understanding of related IT disciplines, using this expertise to adapt departmental plans.
  • Recommend innovative solutions and best practices for virtual desktop infrastructure that align with strategic objectives and enhance user experience.
  • Perform a variety of complex and non-complex tasks related to virtual desktop management, analysis, and troubleshooting.
  • Analyze problems thoroughly to understand their root causes, supporting the delivery of solutions to complex issues where clear precedents may not exist.
  • Follow specific functional policies and broad procedures, choosing appropriate tactics to reach established goals within the virtual desktop domain.
Impact/Dimensions
  • Contributes to process improvements and the execution of key virtual desktop activities, directly influencing operational efficiency and user productivity.
  • Adapts departmental plans and recommends solutions/best practices based on in-depth knowledge of virtual desktop infrastructure, impacting IT service delivery.
  • Decisions and problem-solving impact the immediate team and departmental projects, ensuring the reliable and performant operation of virtual desktop services.
Management/Leadership
  • Manages projects and processes related to virtual desktop infrastructure independently, operating with limited supervision.
  • Provides technical leadership and guidance to professionals and/or support staff, acting as a resource for less experienced colleagues.
  • Adheres to specific functional policy and broad procedure, choosing appropriate tactics to reach established goals within the virtual desktop domain.
Knowledge and Technical Competencies
  • In-depth expertise in virtual desktop infrastructure (VDI) technologies (e.g., VMware Horizon, Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops, Microsoft AVD).
  • Strong understanding of operating systems (Windows, Linux), active directory, group policy, and profile management solutions.
  • Proficiency in scripting and automation (e.g., PowerShell) for VDI environment management.
  • Experience with cloud-based VDI solutions and hybrid cloud architectures.
  • Advanced analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex performance and connectivity issues.
  • Excellent communication skills, capable of explaining complex technical information clearly to diverse audiences.
Minimum Requirements: Education/Experience
Bachelor's degree (Master's may be preferred) with 11 - 14 years of position-related functional experience in virtual desktop engineering or a related IT field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

We work alongside our customers at both ends of the value chain to deliver quality products and develop tailored, innovative solutions that address evolving consumer needs. title: Key Account Manager - Travel (Gerente de Contas Estratégicas - Travel) - São Paulo (Hybrid)
description:
Ready to Accelerate Your Career?

Clara is the fastest-growing company in Latin America. We've built the leading solution for companies to make and manage all their payments. We already help over 20,000 large and growing businesses operate with agility and financial clarity through locally issued corporate cards, bill pay, financing, and a powerful B2B platform built for scale.

Clara is backed by some of the most successful investors in the world, including top regional VCs like Monashees, Kaszek, and Canary, and leading global funds like Notable Capital, Coatue, DST Global Partners, ICONIQ Growth, General Catalyst, Citi Ventures, SV Angel, Citius, Endeavor Catalyst, and Goldman Sachs – in addition to dozens of angel investors and local family offices.

We’re building the financial infrastructure that powers high‑performing organizations across the region. We invite you to join us if you want to be part of a fast‑paced environment that will accelerate your career and support you to do some of the best work of your life alongside a passionate and committed team distributed across the Americas.

What You’ll Do

We're looking for a Key Account Manager (Strategic CSM) to drive Clara’s growth within the Travel & Tourism industry – one of our most strategic verticals. You will be responsible for managing and expanding our relationship with high‑value clients such as TMCs (Travel Management Companies), tour operators, and agencies, positioning Clara as the backbone of their financial operations.

In this role, you won’t just manage a portfolio; you will act as a strategic partner, helping travel companies navigate complex payment flows, optimize liquidity, and automate the grueling process of travel expense reconciliation.

You Will

  • Act as the primary point of contact for large players in the travel industry, ensuring Clara is deeply integrated into their daily financial and operational workflows.
  • Identify opportunities to migrate travel‑specific spend (GDS settlements, hotel guarantees, and supplier payments) to Clara’s ecosystem, driving revenue through upselling and cross‑selling.
  • Deep dive into clients' back‑office processes to solve travel‑specific pain points, such as VCN issuance for hotel bookings and real‑time reconciliation of travel expenses.
  • Conduct regular strategic reviews with CFOs and Finance Directors of TMCs and operators to demonstrate ROI, ensure Net Revenue Retention, and minimize churn.
  • Partner with Product and Operations teams to build and refine features tailored for the travel sector, for example specific ERP integrations or reporting formats for travel agencies.
  • Stay ahead of travel industry trends (IATA regulations, NDC, corporate travel recovery) to position Clara as a thought leader.

Who You Are

  • Industry expertise: Minimum 5+ years of experience within the Travel/Tourism sector (at or with TMCs, GDS providers, or travel tech companies) in roles such as account management, sales, or financial operations.
  • Financial literacy: Solid understanding of travel financial cycles, including settlement processes, supplier payments, and corporate credit needs.
  • Consultative mindset: Proven track record of managing long‑term corporate relationships and driving account expansion based on technical and operational value.
  • Location: Availability to work in person at our office in Itaim Bibi (at least twice a week) and travel to key clients across Brazil.
  • Communication: Ability to pitch complex financial solutions to C‑suite executives, especially CFOs focused on cash flow and operational efficiency.
  • Languages: Working proficiency in English and fluency in Portuguese.
  • AI enthusiast: Experience or strong interest in using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity) to automate client intelligence and internal workflows.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience or familiarity with outbound and automation infrastructure tools such as Amplemarket or N8N.
  • Basic proficiency in Spanish or a strong desire to learn it.
  • Independent analytical skills using spreadsheets, SQL, or Python to evaluate portfolio health and data.
  • A good sense of humor.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and stock options (ESOP) from day one.
  • Multicultural team with daily exposure to Portuguese, Spanish, and English.
  • Annual learning budget and internal accelerated development paths.
  • High‑ownership environment: fast learning and raising the bar together.
  • Smart, ambitious teammates – low ego, high impact.
  • Flexible vacation and hybrid work model focused on results.

description:
Aqui no Grupo Carrefour Brasil vivemos o #NossoJeitoDeSer todos os dias. O Cliente está no centro da Excelência em tudo o que fazemos, e é ele quem guia nossas decisões e inspira nossas entregas. Nosso trabalho é construído tendo como base Compromisso com o Resultado , e com foco em Cooperar, Desenvolver e Formar nosso Time , pois sabemos que quando uma pessoa cresce, ela leva outras consigo.

E cultivamos um ambiente de Inclusão e Orgulho em Pertencer à Família , onde todas as pessoas são respeitadas, valorizadas e incentivadas a serem quem realmente são.

Se identificou com a nossa cultura e nossos valores? Então vem fazer parte do nosso time!

Missão do Cargo:

Conduzir a estrutura de negócios e Growth da Tribo de Empréstimos, sendo responsável desenvolver, priorizar e conduzir iniciativas buscando impulsionar o crescimento e a rentabilidade do portfólio dos produtos Empréstimos Pessoal, Consignado e Pix Crédito. O foco principal é definir a visão expansão da carteira e retenção, direcionando junto com o time a execução de estratégias de canais, segmentação, campanhas, pricing, crédito e rentabilidade.

Principais Responsabilidades:

Definir, direcionar e gerir o roadmap para o produto de empréstimos (Crédito Pessoal, Consignado e Pix Crédito), estabelecendo metas claras de originação, volume de crédito e receita;

Liderar a estratégia de aquisição e conversão end-to-end, conduzir testes junto com o time de produtos de oferta e pricing;

Monitorar o P&L (Profit and Loss) da vertical. Garantir que as estratégias de crescimento estejam em sintonia com as políticas de crédito, equilibrando a expansão da carteira com o monitoramento da inadimplência e perdas;

Realizar a análise constante do mercado competitivo e das tendências macroeconômicas, identificando novas oportunidades para garantir a rentabilidade de longo prazo do produto;

Atuar em conjunto com CRM, Marketing, Crédito, BI e Produtos para garantir sinergia das iniciativas de aquisição e ativação.

Requisitos e Qualificações

Ensino superior completo em Engenharia, Economia, Estatística, Administração, Marketing ou áreas correlatas (Pós-graduação/MBA desejável).

Inglês Avançado para interlocução estratégica e acompanhamento de tendências globais;

Domínio do Pacote Office, com foco em apresentações executivas e análises complexas em Excel;

Forte capacidade analítica, com experiência comprovada em estudos de indicadores financeiros e relatórios estratégicos;

Experiência em aquisição de clientes e gestão de produtos de crédito/empréstimos em grandes instituições financeiras, fintechs ou varejo;

Atuação em Growth, Business, Crédito ou CRM, como conhecimento em gestão de funil de vendas e otimização de rentabilidade;

Experiência em atuação de projetos multidisciplinares e gestão de stakeholders;

Mentalidade criativa e paixão por inovação e melhoria contínua de processos.

Domínio de ferramentas de colaboração e gestão de projetos (Kanbanize e Miro);

Conhecimento prático em ferramentas de extração e visualização de dados;

Experiência prévia em gestão de portfólios de larga escala no varejo ou bancos digitais.

description:
Job description

O Arquiteto de Soluções será responsável por desenvolver soluções técnicas que atendam às necessidades dos clientes, trabalhando em estreita colaboração com as equipes de vendas e engenharia para assegurar que as propostas sejam viáveis e alinhadas com as capacidades da Claranet.   • Desenvolver soluções técnicas personalizadas para os clientes, alinhadas com as capacidades e ofertas da Claranet;
  • Colaborar com as equipes de vendas e engenharia para identificar as necessidades dos clientes e desenvolver propostas técnicas que atendam a essas necessidades;
  • Elaborar arquiteturas de sistemas que integrem diferentes tecnologias e soluções, assegurando a viabilidade técnica dos projetos;

  • Garantir que as soluções propostas estejam alinhadas com as melhores práticas de segurança, desempenho e escalabilidade;
  • Manter-se atualizado com as novas tecnologias e tendências do mercado, aplicando esse conhecimento no desenvolvimento de soluções inovadoras;
  • Fornecer suporte técnico durante o processo de venda, auxiliando na negociação de contratos e no esclarecimento de questões técnicas.

Requirements and skills

  • Graduação completa em Engenharia da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Ciência da Computação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Pós-graduação ou MBA em: Arquitetura de Soluções, Infraestrutura de TI, Segurança da Informação ou Gestão de Tecnologia
  • Cloud Computing: Domínio de arquiteturas em Azure, AWS e/ou Google Cloud Platform (GCP);
  • Virtualização e Containers: Experiência com VMware, Hyper‑V, Docker, Kubernetes;
  • Infraestrutura de Redes: Conhecimento em LAN/WAN, SD‑WAN, firewalls, VPN, load balancers;
  • Sistemas Operacionais: Administração avançada de Windows Server, Linux, e ambientes híbridos;
  • Monitoramento e Gestão: Ferramentas como Zabbix, Nagios, Prometheus, Grafana, SolarWinds;
  • Automação e Infraestrutura como Código (IaC): Uso de Terraform, Ansible, PowerShell, Bash;
  • Segurança da Informação: Conhecimento em Zero Trust, IAM, SIEM, NAC, Backup & Recovery
  • Certificações desejáveis: AWS Solutions Architect, Cisco CCNA/CCNP, Fortinet NSE ou VMware VCP

description:
The primary focus of the Business Credit Officer (BCO) Analyst is owning the E2E (End to End) process of credit for CIB customers in order to support Relationship Managers to structure credit solutions according to financial needs of Corporate and Multinational customers that would increase lending portfolio in HSBC and ultimately would be translated in reaching economic objectives of the bank.

Increasing lending portfolio: (i) Contribute with RMs to structure credit short-termed or long-termed financial solutions for corporate customers; (ii) Identify and assess risks of these financings in order to ensure that credit risk is properly mitigated and the deal complies with Brazilian banking regulation and internal policies of HSBC; (iii) prepare Credit applications 100% written in English where the analyst is expected to undertake an exhaustive assessment ofthe customer that includes: analysis of financial statements, industry analysis, annual projections of customers to predict repayment capacity.

Portfolio monitoring: (i) work closely with Relationship Managers and clients to monitor compliance of financial and non-financial terms of the lending portfolio in order to detect a negative trend of the customer or industry that would ultimately have effects on our customers; (ii) ensure completeness of the credit file in order to facilitate operations of credits.

Customer facing: (i) be in contact with customers in order to follow up documentation to facilitate the portfolio management assigned to the analyst; (ii) be in contact with the customer to obtain firsthand, valuable information from the customer in order to undertake thorough analysis of the Borrowers for monitoring purposes or increase the lending portfolio.

This role is part of the Cybersecurity team and focuses on the design, governance, and operation of identities used by AI agents and automation components. The person in this position will ensure secure, compliant, and auditable interactions between agentic systems and enterprise platforms, applying strong identity governance and least-privilege principles.

  • Design and build the Agent Identity Governance Framework, including standards, approval models, lifecycle rules, and access catalogues;

  • Strong knowledge of identity lifecycle management for non-human identities;
  • Solid understanding of identity and access management concepts such as RBAC, ABAC, entitlements, and approval workflows;
  • Experience with identity standards and protocols such as OAuth2, OIDC, SAML, SCIM, and directory services;
  • Knowledge of privileged access patterns, including just-in-time and just-enough access;
  • Experience with API-based integrations and log analysis;

  • Advanced English proficiency;
  • Availability to work onsite in Betim (MG), Brazil.

description:
BASE SALARY - USD 36,000-48,000K/YEAR BONUS - UP TO USD 24,000/YEAR

Our client is founded on the belief that the majority of the world’s population is deprived of the opportunity to reach their full potential. They are betting their lives on this by creating a system that identifies high‑potential talent in low‑opportunity environments and prepares them for lucrative technical careers. Based in Brazil, their intensive apprenticeship program immerses participants in real‑world commercial work through our analytics consultancy serving US businesses. This approach not only eliminates the financial barrier of education, often prohibitive for underprivileged populations, but also offers learners a comfortable wage from day one, enabling them to fully concentrate on mastering a new profession. They have found this model to be the most effective way of creating new analytics talent with proven ability to solve real‑life business challenges.

What You’ll Do

Core Goal: Deliver excellent customer solutions via reliable, high‑quality data analyses, strong communication, and top‑tier problem solving. You will be a hire at our early‑stage, profitable startup. We are still figuring out many aspects of this business, and we’re looking for a hands‑on thought partner to help build the company while managing a client relationship day‑to‑day. We want to be upfront: this is not a 9‑5 job, and it’s really difficult at times, but our shared mission to serve is what we rally around.

Client Relationships

You’ll be the primary point of contact for one client to start, which is a US‑based company. This client treats us as an integrated part of their data team, and this project will require strong business acumen, SQL, and BI skills (ex. Looker/Tableau). Our typical workflow consists of scoping work, completing the work, performing QA, and presenting to the client. As you prove our ability to solve customer problems, you’ll look for opportunities to expand our footprint within each business.

Analyst Training + Management

At the beginning, you will be working on your own. However, our goal is for this role to grow into a people management role. Once you reach that stage, you’ll manage and coach a team of analysts who are true beginners. They typically won’t have college degrees and they’ll have no prior analytics experience whatsoever. Our analysts have previously worked as receptionists, delivery drivers, waiters, and in other non‑technical roles. You’re not just going to be teaching them SQL/analysis/critical thinking, but also how to navigate a different culture in their second language (English) and gain confidence in their new skills. Most importantly, you’ll be transforming their lives by changing their mindsets about what’s possible through coaching them to independently solve hard problems. If done right, we believe you will be empowering a new learner to sustainably 10x their income in 2 years or less.

Company Overview

We’re Checkout.com – you might not know our name, but companies like eBay, ASOS, Klarna, Uber Eats, and Sony do. That moment when you check out online? We make it happen. Checkout.com is where the world checks out. Our global network powers billions of transactions every year, making money move without making a fuss. A role here isn’t just another job; it’s a career‑defining opportunity to build the future of fintech.

Global payments are complex and ever‑evolving. At Checkout.com, our software engineers develop the next‑generation payments technologies that enable our merchants to boost their acceptance rates, cut processing costs, fight fraud, and create cutting‑edge solutions that enable extraordinary customer experiences. We’re looking for senior software engineers who bring fresh ideas, have a curious nature, and are passionate about working in an engineering environment that focuses on building products to achieve the company’s strategic goals.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will lead and drive specific projects critical to Checkout’s needs, with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast‑paced business grow and evolve. You will design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and enhance software solutions across the full stack while guiding project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables.

  • Define and design loosely coupled, scalable systems in a microservices architecture using industry best practices.

  • Write clean, maintainable, extendable, and testable code on some of Checkout’s most impactful systems.
  • Build, own, and operate your systems to the highest levels of resilience and service.
  • Mentor junior team members and assist in their technical development.
  • Collaborate with cross‑functional teams including product management across a large engineering community.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
  • Proficiency in C#.NET, Java, or Go, with a strong understanding of software development principles in either a backend or full‑stack environment.
  • Great communication skills and ability to interact effectively with a wide range of stakeholders.
  • Experience working in agile environments and delivering high‑quality code within tight deadlines.
  • Excellent problem‑solving skills and the ability to work independently as well as part of a team.
  • AI proficiency or curiosity is a plus; a appetite to embrace what the latest technology has to offer to enhance your and your team’s productivity.
  • Payments or financial knowledge is a plus but not required.

Benefits and Culture

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive – through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one. Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here. We’re committed to setting you up for success and making our process as accessible as possible. If you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable, please let us know.

Life at Checkout.com is balanced. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

title: Senior Software Engineer I
description:
Company Overview

We’re Checkout.com – you might not know our name, but companies like eBay, ASOS, Klarna, Uber Eats, and Sony do. That moment when you check out online? We make it happen. Checkout.com is where the world checks out. Our global network powers billions of transactions every year, making money move without making a fuss. We spent years perfecting a service most people will never notice. Because when digital payments just work, businesses grow, customers stay, and no one stops to think about why. With 19 offices spanning six continents, we feel at home everywhere – but London is our HQ. Wherever our people work their magic, they’re fast‑moving, performance‑obsessed, and driven by being better every day. A role here isn’t just another job; it’s a career‑defining opportunity to build the future of fintech.

Role Overview

Global payments are complex and ever‑evolving. At Checkout.com, our software engineers develop the next‑generation payments technologies that enable our merchants to boost their acceptance rates, cut processing costs, fight fraud, and create cutting‑edge solutions that enable extraordinary customer experiences. We’re looking for senior software engineers who bring fresh ideas, have a curious nature, and are passionate about working in an engineering environment that focuses on building products to achieve the company’s strategic goals.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will lead and drive specific projects critical to Checkout’s needs, with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast‑paced business grow and evolve. You will design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and enhance software solutions across the full stack while guiding project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables.

Responsibilities and Impact

  • Define and design loosely coupled, scalable systems in a microservices architecture using industry best practices.
  • Stay up‑to‑date with, use, and spread knowledge of the latest technologies used by Checkout.com.
  • Write clean, maintainable, extendable, and testable code on some of Checkout’s most impactful systems.
  • Build, own, and operate your systems to the highest levels of resilience and service.
  • Mentor junior team members and assist in their technical development.
  • Collaborate with cross‑functional teams including product management across a large engineering community.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
  • Proficiency in C#.NET, Java, or Go, with a strong understanding of software development principles in either a backend or full‑stack environment.
  • Great communication skills and ability to interact effectively with a wide range of stakeholders.
  • Experience working in agile environments and delivering high‑quality code within tight deadlines.
  • Excellent problem‑solving skills and the ability to work independently as well as part of a team.
  • AI proficiency or curiosity is a plus; a appetite to embrace what the latest technology has to offer to enhance your and your team’s productivity.
  • Payments or financial knowledge is a plus but not required.

Benefits and Culture

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive – through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one. Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here. We’re committed to setting you up for success and making our process as accessible as possible. If you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable, please let us know.

Life at Checkout.com is balanced. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

title: Programa Banco de Talentos: Analista de Laboratório Sênior (Diversas Localidades)
description:
Descrição da empresa

A Eurofins Scientific é uma empresa internacional de ciências da vida, fornecendo uma gama exclusiva de serviços de testes analíticos para clientes em vários setores, para tornar a vida e o ambiente mais seguros, saudáveis e sustentáveis. Desde os alimentos que você come, até a água que você bebe, e os medicamentos nos quais você confia, a Eurofins trabalha com as maiores empresas do mundo para garantir que os produtos fornecidos sejam seguros, seus ingredientes autênticos e a rotulagem exata. A Eurofins acredita que é líder global em testes de produtos alimentícios, ambientais, farmacêuticos e cosméticos e em serviços de agrociência CRO. É também um dos líderes mundiais independentes de mercado em determinados serviços de testes e laboratório para genômica, farmacologia de descoberta, forense, CDMO, ciências avançadas de materiais e no apoio a estudos clínicos. Em apenas 30 anos, a Eurofins cresceu de um laboratório em Nantes, França, para mais de 47.000 funcionários em uma rede de mais de 900 empresas independentes em mais de 50 países e operando mais de 800 laboratórios. A Eurofins oferece um portfólio de mais de 200.000 métodos analíticos para avaliar a segurança, identidade, composição, autenticidade, origem, rastreabilidade e pureza de substâncias e produtos biológicos, além de fornecer serviços inovadores de testes de diagnóstico clínico, como um dos principais players emergentes globais em teste de diagnóstico clínico especializado. Em 2019, a Eurofins gerou receita total de EUR 4,56 bilhões e está entre as ações com melhor desempenho na Europa nos últimos 20 anos.

Descrição do emprego

Assistir a Coordenação técnica, além de orientar os técnicos juniores e plenos, auxiliares e estagiários. Executar as técnicas analíticas descritas nos procedimentos da empresa, com análise crítica dos resultados, atendendo aos prazos, mantendo a organização e zelando pela segurança e integridade de todos.

Responsabilidades

  • Iniciar a liderança do time com auxílio e apoio da coordenação da área, considerando valores e Leadership Charter da Eurofins (consulte site ou Princípios Corporativos);
  • Realizar e supervisionar as diferentes etapas analíticas, incluindo pesagem e homogeneização;
  • Participar nas validações, no que tange as etapas analíticas;
  • Comunicar com a área de cadastro (Login) quanto às amostras em processamento;
  • Definir com o auxílio do Coordenador e/ou área comercial a prioridade de realização das análises;
  • Realizar o treinamento de novos profissionais;
  • Realizar a conferência e validação de resultados analíticos / análises críticas;
  • Incluir resultados avaliados, repetições e análises adicionais no sistema Lims, bem como registrar informações pertinentes;
  • Coordenar os ensaios de proficiência quanto a prazo e execução;
  • Coordenar a solução de problemas da rotina do laboratório, envolvendo a Coordenação quando necessário;
  • Realizar / solicitar / acompanhar a manutenção corretiva e preventiva dos equipamentos;
  • Oferecer suporte no controle de estoque de materiais do laboratório;
  • Auxiliar no envio de materiais para calibração;
  • Organizar o laboratório para o preparo de materiais (soluções, tampões, meios de cultura, soluções padrão), checagem de temperaturas, validade das soluções e reagentes em uso;
  • Orientar constantemente o time para limpeza e organização das áreas com foco em segurança no laboratório;
  • Assegurar que todos os formulários sejam preenchidos corretamente;
  • Supervisar e obter o planejamento das análises no sistema Lims;
  • Realizar a solicitação de compras de materiais para o laboratório no sistema;
  • Acompanhar o arquivamento de documentos da rotina, assegurando que os mesmos estão de acordo com treinamento da Qualidade;
  • Revisar e atualizar procedimentos no Sistema de Gestão da Qualidade;
  • Acompanhar visitas e auditorias no laboratório;
  • Ser responsável técnico pelos órgãos de acreditação e credenciamento.
  • Deverá realizar o contato com o cliente quando necessário.

Outras Responsabilidades

  • Apresentar atitudes coerentes com os valores da Eurofins – consulte site ou Manual de Integração;
  • Respeitar os requisitos QSMS (ABNT NBR ISO/IEC 17025, ABNT NBR ISO 14001 e BS OHSAS 18001);
  • Substituir a Coordenação técnica, quando necessário;
  • Comprometimento com a melhoria contínua, desenvolvimento do sistema de gestão de qualidade, saúde, meio ambiente e segurança na organização e os aspectos/impactos e perigos/riscos das suas atividades.

Qualificações

  • VISÃO - Definir e comunicar uma visão e estratégia claras.
  • METAS - Definir metas ambiciosas baseadas na estratégia e visão.
  • OBSESSÃO PELOS CLIENTES - Ser um parceiro confiável e fidedigno para o cliente.
  • CONTRATAR OS MELHORES - Atrair, desenvolver e reter desempenhos de destaque.
  • INSPIRAR - Inspirar paixão para alcançar excelente performance.
  • EMPODERAR - Empoderar e motivar a equipe.
  • EXECUÇÃO - Garantir que as estratégias são implementadas.
  • RESULTADOS & PROPRIEDADE - Entregar crescimento rentável e sustentável.
  • ACÇÃO - Encorajar pró-atividade e iniciativa.
  • SER O MODELO - Liderar pelo exemplo e ganhar confiança.
  • INICIAR MUDANÇA - Iniciar e conduzir mudança em um futuro incerto.
  • SEM FRONTEIRAS - Possibilitar/promover a construção de uma rede interna para otimizar oportunidades de negócios.

  • Experiência Específica: Comprovação de atuação em projetos de drenagem pluvial, macro e microdrenagem, preferencialmente em áreas industriais ou complexos logísticos/armazenadores.
  • Conhecimento Normativo: Domínio das normas da ABNT relacionadas a instalações hidráulicas e de drenagem, além das normas específicas da Conab para certificação de unidades armazenadoras.
  • Software: Proficiência em softwares de modelagem e cálculo hidráulico (como AutoCAD, Civil 3D ou similares).

Company Description

A Serasa Experian é a primeira e a maior Datatech do Brasil. Com sede corporativa em Dublin, Irlanda, a Experian está listada na Bolsa de Valores de Londres (EXPN) e compõe o índice FTSE 100.

Job Description

A Serasa Experian segue em um ritmo acelerado de crescimento e evolução do nosso ecossistema de negócios, ampliando continuamente nossa atuação comercial, capacidades analíticas e soluções de mercado. Pensando nos próximos movimentos estratégicos da companhia, buscamos profissionais executivos da área comercial que tenham interesse em atuar em um ambiente altamente inovador, orientado à performance, transformação e geração de impacto para o negócio. Esse movimento faz parte da nossa estratégia contínua de conexão com talentos que possam, ao longo da nossa jornada de expansão, contribuir diretamente para o crescimento sustentável do negócio e fortalecimento das nossas verticais comerciais. Mais do que acompanhar a transfomação de mercado, buscamos profissionais com visão consultiva, forte capacidade de construção de relacionamento, olhar estratégico e protagonismo para impulsionar resultados em um cenário cada vez mais dinâmico e orientado a dados.

Qualifications

O que buscamos em você:

  • Sólido conhecimento em crédito, com domínio de processos de concessão de crédito, seja na perspectiva de usuário, originador ou fornecedor de soluções.
  • Background consistente no ecossistema financeiro, com experiência em instituições de pagamentos, fintechs e cooperativas de crédito.
  • Vivência prática na utilização de ferramentas de gestão comercial, como CRM (ex.: Salesforce), com disciplina na gestão de pipeline e acompanhamento de oportunidades.
  • Experiência estruturada em atuação comercial no modelo hunter, com forte capacidade de priorização e geração de novas oportunidades de negócio.
  • Capacidade analítica aplicada à gestão de carteira, incluindo acompanhamento de indicadores, evolução de pipeline e tomada de decisão orientada a dados.
  • Alta autonomia na gestão da carteira, com capacidade de atuar de forma independente na identificação, desenvolvimento e fechamento de oportunidades.
  • Perfil com mentalidade de “empreendedor dentro do negócio”, assumindo responsabilidade por resultados e expansão de receita.
  • Atuação como facilitador e orquestrador interno, conectando áreas, recursos e stakeholders para viabilizar soluções e destravar negócios.
  • Senioridade para lidar com ambientes pouco estruturados, tomando decisões e definindo prioridades com segurança.
  • Postura inconformada e orientada à melhoria contínua, com capacidade de desafiar abordagens tradicionais e impulsionar resultados.

Diferencial

  • Inglês avançado

Quais Serão Às Suas Principais Responsabilidades

  • Gerir de forma autônoma a carteira de clientes, sendo responsável pela identificação, priorização e desenvolvimento de oportunidades comerciais.
  • Atuar com mentalidade empreendedora, liderando iniciativas para expansão de receita e abertura de novos negócios no segmento financeiro.
  • Conduzir processos de venda com abordagem consultiva, especialmente em soluções relacionadas a crédito e concessão de crédito.
  • Atuar como especialista em temas de crédito, apoiando clientes na compreensão de modelos, políticas e estratégias de concessão.
  • Orquestrar stakeholders internos (produto, risco, tecnologia, etc.) para viabilizar soluções complexas e destravar negociações.
  • Utilizar ferramentas de CRM (ex.: Salesforce) para gestão estruturada do pipeline, previsibilidade de receita e acompanhamento de performance.
  • Prospecção ativa (hunter), com disciplina na priorização de contas e geração contínua de novas oportunidades.
  • Conduzir negociações complexas, garantindo alinhamento entre necessidades do cliente e viabilidade técnica/comercial das soluções.
  • Desenvolver relacionamento com players do ecossistema financeiro, incluindo bancos, fintechs, instituições de pagamento e cooperativas.
  • Atuar como facilitador interno, conectando áreas e recursos para acelerar ciclos de venda e entrega de valor ao cliente.
  • Acompanhar indicadores de desempenho da carteira, tomando decisões baseadas em dados para maximizar resultados.
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre tendências do mercado de crédito e pagamentos, assegurando relevância nas interações comerciais.

Additional Information

Na Serasa Experian, acreditamos que a diversidade é fundamental para um ambiente de trabalho mais saudável e inovador, onde todas as pessoas possam trocar experiências e expressar suas ideias. Por isso, contamos com diversas ações para promover um recrutamento inclusivo e apoiar no desenvolvimento profissional das nossas pessoas. Além disso, temos os nossos grupos de afinidade, criados para empoderar e acolher as pessoas de grupos sub-representados: ExperianPride (comunidade LGBTQIAPN+), Ubuntu (equidade racial), Women in Experian (equidade de gênero) e aspire (pessoas com deficiência) e Connecting Generations (gerações).

Estamos em busca de um Técnico de Manutenção de Campo (região metropolitana de Belo Horizonte, MG) para levar a excelência da Kärcher diretamente aos nossos clientes.

  • Atendimento de Campo Completo : Realizar instalação, manutenção preventiva e corretiva de equipamentos diretamente nas instalações dos clientes.

  • Visão Preditiva : Realizar check-ups completos nos equipamentos durante os atendimentos para identificar e prevenir falhas futuras, minimizando o tempo de máquina parada (downtime).
  • Capacitação de Usuários : Ministrar treinamentos técnicos sobre a operação correta e o uso adequado dos equipamentos para os clientes.
  • Documentação Técnica : Registrar os serviços realizados e peças substituídas de forma clara e organizada.

  • Experience in Go; proficiency with SQL and at least one modern database (PostgreSQL, TimescaleDB, InfluxDB, Redis).
  • Solid understanding of algorithms, data structures, and distributed systems architecture.

  • Hands‑on experience with Linux, Docker, Git, and debugging tools.
  • Understanding of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, HTTP).
  • Excellent written and verbal communication; ability to collaborate across globally distributed teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior work in IoT systems, industrial automation, or energy/solar systems using MQTT or RabbitMQ.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP).
  • Experience with monitoring/observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, Jaeger).
  • Additional proficiency in C/C++ or Python.

title: Total Rewards Manager
description:
Role in Our Mission

Total Rewards Manager driving the execution of global compensation, performance, benefits, and payroll programs in high-performance environments at NEXT Ventures. Partnering with HR, Finance, and leadership to deliver data-driven incentive modeling, performance analytics, compliant reward outcomes, and accurate, on-time payroll across regions. Ensuring pay-for-performance, governance excellence, and operational rigor across global teams.

Compensation & Total Rewards Execution

  • Execute and maintain global compensation frameworks aligned with the firm's trading performance culture, innovation objectives, and growth mindset.
  • Support the design and administration of compensation structures across trading, technology, research, and operations functions.
  • Support the annual compensation cycle, including data preparation, bonus pool modeling support, calibration inputs, and executive compensation analytics.
  • Administer short-term and long-term incentive programs (STI, LTIP, deferred compensation), ensuring accurate calculations, payouts, and documentation.
  • Prepare compensation benchmarking, market analysis, and scenario modeling to support decisions by the CPO, CFO, and Executive Committee.
  • Translate compensation strategy into detailed execution plans, tools, and guidelines for HRBPs and business leaders.

Performance Management & OKR Operations

  • Operationalize the global performance management framework, including OKR tracking, review cycles, calibration data, and reporting.
  • Support alignment of individual and team OKRs with trading strategies, business goals, and PnL outcomes through data analysis and reporting.
  • Partner with HRBPs and senior leaders to define measurable performance metrics and scoring methodologies.
  • Manage performance review timelines, system configuration, and data integrity across regions.
  • Produce performance insights and analytics that directly inform compensation, promotion, and recognition outcomes.
  • Act as the subject-matter expert for performance management systems (e.g., HiBob, Revolut), ensuring accuracy, consistency, and user adoption.

Benefits, Wellbeing & Retention Programs

  • Execute and maintain global and regional benefits programs in alignment with retention objectives and local market practices.
  • Conduct benefits benchmarking, cost analysis, utilization tracking, and vendor performance reviews.
  • Support the rollout and continuous improvement of wellbeing initiatives covering physical, mental, and financial wellness.
  • Prepare ROI analyses, utilization reports, and insights to inform benefits optimization decisions.

Payroll & Expatriate Mobility

  • Oversee monthly payroll execution across APAC entities, ensuring full compliance with local statutory requirements, tax filings, and year-end reporting.
  • Maintain payroll data accuracy across HRIS and payroll systems, and partner with Finance on reconciliations, accruals, and audits.
  • Manage relationships with regional payroll vendors and statutory authorities, and resolve employee payroll queries with discretion.
  • Lead the full work permit and employment pass lifecycle across APAC markets, including new applications, renewals, cancellations, and dependent passes.
  • Track expatriate quotas, expiry timelines, and regulatory changes across APAC immigration frameworks to avoid lapses.
  • Support relocation logistics and documentation alongside Talent Acquisition and People Ops.
  • Prepare payroll dashboards, headcount cost reports, and mobility analytics for leadership review.

Governance, Compliance & Risk Management

  • Ensure accurate execution of compensation, benefits, and payroll programs in compliance with local employment, tax, and regulatory requirements across SEA, South Asia, and EMEA.
  • Maintain governance documentation, approval workflows, audit trails, and compensation and payroll records.
  • Partner with Legal, Finance, and HRBPs to operationalize clawback, malus, and deferred compensation mechanisms.
  • Support internal audits, regulatory reviews, and data requests related to compensation, benefits, payroll, and mobility.

What You Bring

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Human Resources, Finance, Economics, or a related discipline.
  • 8+ years of progressive HR experience, including 5+ years in leadership roles across Total Rewards, Performance, or Payroll.
  • Hands-on ownership of multi-country APAC payroll and end-to-end expatriate work permit management.
  • Deep expertise in trading and investment compensation models (PnL-based, discretionary, deferred).
  • Proven success designing OKR or performance frameworks in fast-scaling, data-driven environments.
  • Working knowledge of APAC employment, tax, and immigration regulations across multiple jurisdictions.
  • Strong financial modeling and analytical skills (Excel, Tableau, Power BI).
  • Proficient in payroll software and HRIS platforms.
  • Exceptional stakeholder management skills, adept at navigating executive and regional complexities.
  • High integrity, discretion, and resilience in high-performance, confidential environments.

Your X-Factor

  • Combines strategic vision with operational precision — designing reward and payroll systems that balance fairness, performance, and compliance.
  • Understands the language of both finance and people, bridging data with motivation.
  • Navigates regulatory and multi-country complexity with calm and clarity.
  • Thrives in fast-moving environments where deadlines are non-negotiable.
  • Champions a performance culture rooted in transparency, accountability, and continuous growth.
